Elon Musk wants to bring Starlink to India. But is Mukesh Ambani standing in his way?
Can Starlink disrupt India's telecom sector? Is Elon Musk about to challenge Jio and Airtel?
Elon Musk’s Starlink has sparked a major debate in India. From the Starlink India controversy to questions about national security, data privacy and competition, this is about much more than just internet connectivity.
